description: This file defines data structures, enumerations, and function declarations related to managing git branches, including setting tracking configurations, creating branches, validating branch names, and checking branch statuses within a repository.

methods.name: dwim_and_setup_tracking
methods.description: Sets up tracking configuration for a new branch based on specified tracking mode.

methods.name: create_branch
methods.description: Creates a new branch in the repository with various options like force, reflog, and tracking.

methods.name: create_branches_recursively
methods.description: Creates a new branch and its submodules recursively, including tracking information.

methods.name: branch_checked_out
methods.description: Returns the path to the worktree where a branch is currently checked out, if any.

methods.name: validate_branchname
methods.description: Validates a branch name and fills a ref in a strbuf; detects if branch exists.

methods.name: validate_new_branchname
methods.description: Validates a potential new branch name, ensuring it can be created properly.

methods.name: remove_merge_branch_state
methods.description: Removes merge-related state from the repository.

methods.name: remove_branch_state
methods.description: Removes working state information from the current branch.

methods.name: install_branch_config
methods.description: Configures local branch to track a remote branch.

methods.name: read_branch_desc
methods.description: Reads the description for a branch.

methods.name: die_if_checked_out
methods.description: Terminates if a branch is checked out in any worktree, with optional messaging.
